The site's own /contact-us page is blank, so the address itself comes from the Yelp listing the site points at. Despite the 'Salad' cuisine tag in the database this is a Chicago-style grill — Italian beef, Vienna Beef dogs, burgers and gyros — with a genuine Greek-dressed salad section. Price freshness was cross-checked and the usual pattern is inverted here: the own site is the FRESHER source. The Uber Eats store page (fPD7jbCgXoKtstwIUy9EXw) carries the old tier — Da Beef $8, Da Sausage $7, Da Beef & Da Sausage $9 vs $12/$10/$13 on the site — but that listing is plainly dead: it shows 'Delivery unavailable', only 2 ratings, and hours of 9:00 AM-11:00 PM that contradict the actual 11am-8pm. Aggregators (allmenus, zmenu) repeat the same stale $8 tier. $8 for an Italian beef in UTC San Diego in 2026 is implausibly low, so the site's tier was used throughout; no fresher first-party source exists (the restaurant has no online ordering — the site only lists a phone number). The site's copyright reads 2025, so prices could still trail the counter slightly. Several items are listed as a base price plus a combo price with a local craft beer (e.g. 'Da Beef $12 Craft beer $14'); the base food price is recorded. 'The Big Shoulders' is written on the site as '$10 w Craft beer/soda', which is inconsistent with that pattern — $10 recorded as the base. The 'Burger Combo Deal' (+$2, adds craft beer and hand-cut fries) is an upsell rather than a dish and is omitted. The three soups are all marked 'Check on availability' on the site.
